text: Miten kuukausittaiset maksut kehittyivät, ja mikä kuukausi oli paras kokonainen kuukausi?

result.reply:
**Lyhyesti:** Paras kokonainen kuukausi oli **maaliskuu 2018**, jolloin maksuja kertyi **622 AUD** (35 tilausta). Kolmen kokonaisen kuukauden aikana maksut kasvoivat tammikuusta maaliskuuhun.

| Kuukausi | Tilauksia | Maksut (AUD) |
|---|---|---|
| Tammikuu 2018 | 29 | 496 |
| Helmikuu 2018 | 27 | 415 |
| **Maaliskuu 2018** | **35** | **622** |
| Huhtikuu 2018 (osittainen, 1.–9.4.) | 8 | 139 |

**Huomioita:**
- Data kattaa ajanjakson 1.1.–9.4.2018. Huhtikuu on kesken, joten se ei ole kokonainen kuukausi, eikä sitä siksi voi verrata muihin. Sen perusteella ei voi sanoa, onko kehitys jatkunut.
- Aineisto on historiallista synteettistä esimerkkidataa, ei nykyisiä liiketoimintalukuja. Vuodet 2018 ovat siis vanhoja, eikä niitä kannata verrata nykyiseen tilanteeseen.
- Luvut ovat maksettuja summia tilauspäivän mukaan kaikilta tilauksilta, myös palautetuilta ja keskeneräisiltä. Ne eivät ole nettotuloa tai kannattavuutta, koska palautuksia tai kuluja ei ole erotettu.

Haluatko, että rajaan luvut vain valmistuneisiin tilauksiin tai näytän kuukausittaisen kehityksen kuvaajana?

parts.text: Miten kuukausittaiset maksut kehittyivät, ja mikä kuukausi oli paras kokonainen kuukausi?

models.name: customers
models.description: This table has basic information about a customer, as well as some derived facts based on a customer's orders
models.grain: One row per customer, including customers with no orders.

models.name: orders
models.description: This table has basic information about orders, as well as some derived facts based on payments

output.name: orders
output.description: This table has basic information about orders, as well as some derived facts based on payments
output.sql:
with order_payments as (
    select
        order_id,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'credit_card' then amount else 0 end) as credit_card_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'coupon' then amount else 0 end) as coupon_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'bank_transfer' then amount else 0 end) as bank_transfer_amount,
        sum(case when payment_method = 'gift_card' then amount else 0 end) as gift_card_amount,
        sum(amount) as amount
    from "jaffle_shop"."main"."stg_payments"
    group by order_id
)

select
    orders.order_id,
    orders.customer_id,
    orders.order_date,
    orders.status,
    order_payments.credit_card_amount,
    order_payments.coupon_amount,
    order_payments.bank_transfer_amount,
    order_payments.gift_card_amount,
    order_payments.amount
from "jaffle_shop"."main"."stg_orders" as orders
left join order_payments
    on orders.order_id = order_payments.order_id

joins: orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id (many orders to one customer).

metrics.amount: Sum of all recorded payments for this order in AUD, including coupons and gift cards, regardless of order status. Not net revenue or profit.
metrics.order_count: COUNT(*) on orders. For completed orders filter status = 'completed'.
metrics.average_order_amount: AVG(amount) on orders; excludes NULL amounts.

caveats: No refund ledger, tax breakdown, costs, or payment timestamps are available.
order_date is the order placement date, not the payment date.
The bundled seeds are historical synthetic data. Inspect MIN/MAX(order_date) before choosing dates.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: This is a unique identifier for an order

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Foreign key to the customers table

columns.name: order_date
columns.description: Date (UTC) that the order was placed

columns.name: status
columns.description:
Orders can be one of the following statuses:

| status         | description                                                                                                            |
| -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| placed         | The order has been placed but has not yet left the warehouse                                                           |
| shipped        | The order has ben shipped to the customer and is currently in transit                                                  |
| completed      | The order has been received by the customer                                                                            |
| return_pending | The customer has indicated that they would like to return the order, but it has not yet been received at the warehouse |
| returned       | The order has been returned by the customer and received at the warehouse                                              |

columns.name: credit_card_amount
columns.description: Amount of the order (AUD) paid for by credit card

columns.name: coupon_amount
columns.description: Amount of the order (AUD) paid for by coupon

columns.name: bank_transfer_amount
columns.description: Amount of the order (AUD) paid for by bank transfer

columns.name: gift_card_amount
columns.description: Amount of the order (AUD) paid for by gift card

input.sql: select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as orders, round(sum(amount),2) as payments_aud, min(order_date) as first_day, max(order_date) as last_day from main.orders group by 1 order by 1

output.sql: select strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') as month, count(*) as orders, round(sum(amount),2) as payments_aud, min(order_date) as first_day, max(order_date) as last_day from main.orders group by 1 order by 1
